relay.help:
{name} {version} (protocol v{protocol})

Usage:
  {cmd} [--config <file>]          start the relay
  {cmd} --check [--config <file>]  only check the config and the certificate files
  {cmd} --version | --help
  --lang <language>                the language of this command's text (en, zh-CN …; default DAISY_LANG, then the system's)

The config file is JSON (see relay.example.json in the package); environment variables override the file:
  DAISY_RELAY_CONFIG           path of the config file
  DAISY_RELAY_DOMAIN           the relay's own domain (a Daisy gets <subdomain>.<domain>)
  DAISY_RELAY_HOST / _PORT     address and port to listen on (default 0.0.0.0:443)
  DAISY_RELAY_TLS_CERT / _KEY  certificate and private key for the relay's own domain (PEM files; no wildcard certificate)
  DAISY_RELAY_LOG_LEVEL        debug | info | warn | error

The protocol: PROTOCOL.md in the package. SIGHUP re-reads the certificate, SIGTERM / SIGINT stop.
